topics.title: BI 1291583 (AIRTIVITY, Study 1397-0018) – NDA Scenario Analysis & Adolescent Recruitment Mitigation

background.text: Three NDA scenarios are defined based on timing of adolescent vs adult recruitment completion and sufficiency of adolescent data at DBL1. Scenario 1 (Global Goal): adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; labelled population includes 12y+ patients with BE; no sNDA required.
background.quote:
Scenario #1 (Global Goal):
Adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; and the labelled population includes 12 year and older patients with BE (no sNDA).

background.text: Scenario 2: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult; available adolescent data at DBL1 may or may not be sufficient; medium-to-high risk of sNDA; China HA may have objections; mitigation is China contributing more adolescent and CF patients.
background.quote:
Medium to high risk of sNDA, depending on the data totality;
China HA may have objections as well

background.text: Scenario 3: Adolescent data at DBL1 is NOT sufficient; sNDA required; China priority review and NRDL premium pricing chance will be much lower.
background.quote: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult recruitment (DBL 1 for adults and DBL 2 for adols.); but the available adolescent data at DBL 1 is NOTsufficient to support label inclusion of adols (sNDA).

background.text: Mitigation plan slide is noted as 'To be updated', indicating the plan is still in draft.
